column1: # KD11-B control store, July 1976 drawing set. Bits as printed; NXT is active low.
# NXTADDR is the decoded next microaddress (MPC complemented). ALUCODE/ALUOP decode
# the 5-bit ALU field against the operation table in EK-KD11B-MM-001. SPA is the
# 4-bit scratchpad address ROM-SPA-3..0, which the listing prints as four separate
# non-adjacent single-bit columns (SP3 SP2 SP1 SP0) and is assembled here.
# Symbolic columns decode the fields per kd11b-fieldvalues.tsv. BUT and BRG are read
